integrity: The minimal automaton, symbolic generating function and potential bound are exact proofs; exhaustive checks up to eleven positions are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite linearly ordered binary words forbidding exactly 000 and 101; existential coordinate shattering. No adaptive Littlestone, cyclic boundary, or general forbidden-set result. Historical uniqueness is not independently certified.
title: A five-state shattering automaton for binary words avoiding two trigrams
